actual_action: A hand inside an open brown leather tote bag moves to touch and press against the interior slip pocket, demonstrating its presence and placement.

artifacts_with_times.description: The movement of the index finger appears unnatural and digitally manipulated. It extends and straightens in a stiff, jerky manner that does not resemble a normal human motion.

limitations: The video only shows a static, top-down view of the bag's interior.
The exterior, sides, bottom, and closure mechanism are not shown.
